followup_explanation:
This query has two notable features: a faintly hostile, impatient tone ("like you always do"), and it's a straightforward expository writing/summarization task with a strict word limit.

On capability, Petrel-235B is the stronger model nearly across the board — higher benchmarks and meaningfully higher internal eval scores on Summarization (86.4 vs 79.9) and Creative Generation, which are the relevant dimensions for a concise expository write-up with tight instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 86.2 also favors Petrel for the word-count constraint).

On preferences, Lapwing self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, so the mildly hostile tone cuts against routing it there. Petrel's preferences are flat across these dimensions, so the tone doesn't bother it.

Both capability and preference-fit point the same direction, so Petrel-235B was the clear choice.
